summary: Initializes an integer-array container object: zeroes the element-count word at this+0x0 and allocates backing storage for a2 integers via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4 * a2), storing the pointer at this+0x4. Returns this as the initialized container.

operations.description: Set the element count at this+0x0 to 0.
Allocate backing storage for a2 integers via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with byte size 4 * a2.
Store the allocated pointer at this+0x4.
Return this so the caller can chain further initialization.
